note: Alberta Parks recreation area 9 km southwest of Fox Creek off Hwy 43, run for the Town of Fox Creek by For-Site Environmental Services: three loops in spruce forest above the north shore of Smoke Lake, with a sandy beach, day-use area and boat launch by the lake. Good pike fishing; kayaks, canoes and paddleboards are rented to campers. A rustic cabin (site C39) is also rented. --Claude
